svg.title: The last inequality follows by exponentiating the preceding one, since ai = e−si. At the comparison radius rk the actual rescaled mesh is aa(k)/rk = mag−1 a(k). The common finite matrices are taken to sublimits along the same comparison filter below the retained ordered filter.
